title: A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Characteristic Two

abstractEnglish: We disprove Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture by constructing a finite field K of characteristic two, a finitely presented group G, and finite sums $`a,b\in K[G]`$ with $`ab=1`$ but $`ba\ne1`$. The group G is nonsofic. The same elements define a cellular automaton on KG that is injective but not surjective, disproving Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture.
